features.quote: End episode when: max turns reached, or model explicitly refuses / gives up, or the task has been clearly shown impossible to a human judge
Turns per episode: fixed length, e.g. 12–20 tool-use turns.
You want enough time for any escalation to emerge, but not so long that the model simply loops mechanically.
features.justification_quote: not so long that the model simply loops mechanically

features.quote: Even though this is model experimentation, it's still worth a review if you're publishing: avoid anthropomorphic overclaims
